title: The Endless Portrait
author: Coral Vasquez
blurb: Sebastian Eastwick, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
